title: Retired Titan IV rockets at Wright-Patterson and McMinnville

tellings.quote: After the launch, the remaining Titan IV rockets were retired. One went to the National Museum of the US Air Force at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base.

plain: Michels says that after a final launch, the remaining Titan IV rockets, large US military launch rockets, were retired, and one went to the National Museum of the US Air Force at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base. He tells this himself, without naming a source, in an episode on NASA and secret science; the other retired rocket is said to have gone to McMinnville, Oregon.
